gear-armour#0000.src: "...But under no circumstances should you stand directly behind an attacking spider. While not a universal trait, some spiders are capable of ejecting webs from their spinneret, leaving assailants and victims helpless." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter {~}
gear-armour#0000.dst: 「……但無論如何都不要站在一隻正在攻擊的蜘蛛正後方。雖然不是所有蜘蛛都這樣，但有些蜘蛛能從絲疣噴出蛛網，讓襲擊者與受害者同樣束手無策。」—Admiral Aegis 的 Nivla 威脅指南，第 {~} 章
gear-armour#0000.flat: "...But under no circumstances should you stand directly behind an attacking spider. While not a universal trait, some spiders are capable of ejecting webs from their spinneret, leaving assailants and victims helpless." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter {~}
gear-armour#0000._raw: "...But under no circumstances should you stand directly behind an attacking spider. While not a universal trait, some spiders are capable of ejecting webs from their spinneret, leaving assailants and victims helpless." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

gear-armour#0001.src: Life itself is not a flexible material to work with-building sentience is precisely like squeezing blood from a stone. It may be years of toil, but the strength of an entire race that looks to you as a creator cannot be overstated.
gear-armour#0001.dst: 生命本身並不是一種好擺弄的材料——要造出有靈之物，簡直就是從石頭裡榨血。那或許得耗上數年苦工，但當一整個種族把你視為造物主，那份力量再怎麼形容都不為過。
gear-armour#0001.flat: Life itself is not a flexible material to work with-building sentience is precisely like squeezing blood from a stone. It may be years of toil, but the strength of an entire race that looks to you as a creator cannot be overstated.

gear-armour#0002.src: Steeped in the deepest energies of the Ahms region void, these ornately-crafted leggings are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0002.dst: 浸透了 Ahms 地區虛空最深處的能量，這件工藝精緻的護腿，只授予擊敗過蜂巢女主人的人。
gear-armour#0002.flat: Steeped in the deepest energies of the Ahms region void, these ornately-crafted leggings are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0003.src: Rumored to be crafted from a Dernic stone, these sinister boots radiate extremely powerful dark energy. They have absorbed the power of the raging seas in their time locked in Sarnfic.
gear-armour#0003.dst: 傳說是用一塊 Dern 之石打造的，這雙陰森的長靴散發著極為強大的黑暗能量。被封在 Sarnfic 的那段歲月裡，它們吸收了怒海的力量。
gear-armour#0003.flat: Rumored to be crafted from a Dernic stone, these sinister boots radiate extremely powerful dark energy. They have absorbed the power of the raging seas in their time locked in Sarnfic.

gear-armour#0004.src: Adamantite is a soft metal often added to exotic medicine to increase one's health, but a revolutionary blacksmith on {p}, created a chestplate with an Adamantite alloy, which is advertised to bolster the users endurance.
gear-armour#0004.dst: 精金是一種柔軟的金屬，常被加進異國藥物裡增進健康；但 {p} 上一位革新派的鐵匠用精金合金打造了一件胸甲，據稱能大幅提升穿戴者的耐力。
gear-armour#0004.flat: Adamantite is a soft metal often added to exotic medicine to increase one's health, but a revolutionary blacksmith on {p}, created a chestplate with an Adamantite alloy, which is advertised to bolster the users endurance.
gear-armour#0004._raw: Adamantite is a soft metal often added to exotic medicine to increase one's health, but a revolutionary blacksmith on Black Road, created a chestplate with an Adamantite alloy, which is advertised to bolster the users endurance.

gear-armour#0005.src: Adherence to the laws of good is important- it's why one fights the spread of corruption, after all. Though whether to follow the spirit or the letter... perhaps they too can be bent to your will.
gear-armour#0005.dst: 恪守良善的律法很重要——畢竟人正是為此才要對抗腐敗的蔓延。不過，究竟該遵守它的精神還是字面……說不定那兩者也都能被你扭到自己想要的樣子。
gear-armour#0005.flat: Adherence to the laws of good is important- it's why one fights the spread of corruption, after all. Though whether to follow the spirit or the letter... perhaps they too can be bent to your will.

gear-armour#0006.src: Keep your eyes forward. The scent of the fresh earth you've kicked up proves you are moving, and the long road ahead proves you have somewhere to be.
gear-armour#0006.dst: 目光向前。你踢起的新土那股氣味證明你正在前進，而前方漫長的路則證明你有個非去不可的地方。
gear-armour#0006.flat: Keep your eyes forward. The scent of the fresh earth you've kicked up proves you are moving, and the long road ahead proves you have somewhere to be.

gear-armour#0007.src: Your limbs fail you, and yet you still stand. Something, someone, has invaded your body, and it will use you until your last breath.
gear-armour#0007.dst: 你的四肢已經不聽使喚，你卻仍然站著。有某個東西、某個人侵入了你的身體，而它會用你用到你嚥下最後一口氣。
gear-armour#0007.flat: Your limbs fail you, and yet you still stand. Something, someone, has invaded your body, and it will use you until your last breath.

gear-armour#0008.src: The expanse of the skies, where the wind whistles a warbling anthem and the air extends onward forever.
gear-armour#0008.dst: 天空的浩瀚之處，風在那裡吹奏著顫動的頌歌，空氣永遠向外延伸。
gear-armour#0008.flat: The expanse of the skies, where the wind whistles a warbling anthem and the air extends onward forever.

gear-armour#0009.src: This item was named by someone from the community!
gear-armour#0009.dst: 這件物品的名字是由社群的某個人取的！
gear-armour#0009.flat: This item was named by someone from the community!

gear-armour#0010.src: It's a strange feeling, running forever to reach the horizon knowing another lies just as far past.
gear-armour#0010.dst: 那是種奇異的感覺：明知地平線之外還有一條同樣遙遠的地平線，卻仍永遠奔跑著追它。
gear-armour#0010.flat: It's a strange feeling, running forever to reach the horizon knowing another lies just as far past.

gear-armour#0011.src: There used to be a constant battle between {p}'s thieves over these feather-light, gold-plated boots, until one day they were stolen by an unknown pickpocket and never seen again.
gear-armour#0011.dst: {p} 的盜賊之間曾為這雙輕如羽毛的鍍金靴子爭鬥不休，直到有一天它被某個不知名的扒手偷走，從此再也沒有出現過。
gear-armour#0011.flat: There used to be a constant battle between {p}'s thieves over these feather-light, gold-plated boots, until one day they were stolen by an unknown pickpocket and never seen again.
gear-armour#0011._raw: There used to be a constant battle between Almuj's thieves over these feather-light, gold-plated boots, until one day they were stolen by an unknown pickpocket and never seen again.

gear-armour#0012.src: Look around and observe! An overcast sky; yet the blue of day seeps through the gloom, illuminating the land around you. A patch of weeds; yet flowers bloom vividly in spite of the wretched foliage surrounding them. The struggles of nature create your own personal utopia. A world, tailormade, just for you. Only you.
gear-armour#0012.dst: 環顧四周，好好看！陰沉的天空——然而白晝的湛藍仍滲過陰霾，照亮你周遭的大地。一片雜草——然而花朵仍在那些可憎的枝葉之間鮮明地綻放。大自然的掙扎造就了屬於你個人的烏托邦。一個為你量身打造的世界。只為你。
gear-armour#0012.flat: Look around and observe! An overcast sky; yet the blue of day seeps through the gloom, illuminating the land around you. A patch of weeds; yet flowers bloom vividly in spite of the wretched foliage surrounding them. The struggles of nature create your own personal utopia. A world, tailormade, just for you. Only you.

gear-armour#0013.src: {p}'s schools of wizardry are notorious for their difficult training regimens. These leg plates, forcing users to balance spellcasting with direct combat, are often cited as the tipping point for successful wizards.
gear-armour#0013.dst: {p} 的巫術學院以嚴苛的訓練課程聞名。這副腿甲迫使使用者在施法與近身戰之間取得平衡，常被視為造就成功巫師的關鍵。
gear-armour#0013.flat: {p}'s schools of wizardry are notorious for their difficult training regimens. These leg plates, forcing users to balance spellcasting with direct combat, are often cited as the tipping point for successful wizards.
gear-armour#0013._raw: Llevigar's schools of wizardry are notorious for their difficult training regimens. These leg plates, forcing users to balance spellcasting with direct combat, are often cited as the tipping point for successful wizards.

gear-armour#0014.src: Despite being a much smaller settlement compared to the mighty citadel of {p}, the dwarven smiths of {p} still can forge mighty products, such as these heavy diamond-alloy boots.
gear-armour#0014.dst: 雖然跟 {p} 那座雄偉的堡壘相比只是個小得多的聚落，{p} 的矮人鐵匠依然能鍛出強悍的產品，比如這雙沉重的鑽石合金靴。
gear-armour#0014.flat: Despite being a much smaller settlement compared to the mighty citadel of {p}, the dwarven smiths of {p} still can forge mighty products, such as these heavy diamond-alloy boots.
gear-armour#0014._raw: Despite being a much smaller settlement compared to the mighty citadel of Rodoroc, the dwarven smiths of Thanos still can forge mighty products, such as these heavy diamond-alloy boots.

gear-armour#0016.src: Andesite is a stone commonly used for weapons and construction, but tends to be ineffective as armor when impure. This sturdy chestplate, however, is testament to the strength of pure andesite.
gear-armour#0016.dst: 安山岩是常用於武器與建築的石材，但雜質多的時候不太適合當護甲。而這件堅實的胸甲，正是純安山岩強度的明證。
gear-armour#0016.flat: Andesite is a stone commonly used for weapons and construction, but tends to be ineffective as armor when impure. This sturdy chestplate, however, is testament to the strength of pure andesite.

gear-armour#0017.src: Out of respect and care for the dead, bovemists cloak them in blessed shrouds to aid their spirits in passing. These efforts, however, are not respected by the dead.
gear-armour#0017.dst: 出於對死者的敬意與關照，牛神信徒會用受祝福的裹布覆蓋他們，好幫助其靈魂安然離去。然而這份心意，死者並不領情。
gear-armour#0017.flat: Out of respect and care for the dead, bovemists cloak them in blessed shrouds to aid their spirits in passing. These efforts, however, are not respected by the dead.

gear-armour#0018.src: Infused with the classical magicks of fire, water, and thunder, this ornately-crafted chestplate is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0018.dst: 灌注了火、水、雷三種古典魔法，這件工藝精緻的胸甲，只授予擊敗過蜂巢女主人的人。
gear-armour#0018.flat: Infused with the classical magicks of fire, water, and thunder, this ornately-crafted chestplate is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0019.src: Only the naive celebrate a ceasefire. Not a second wasted, a merciless arms race against the inevitability of war has left you ready to unleash hell the moment the armistice breaks.
gear-armour#0019.dst: 只有天真的人才會慶祝停火。你一秒也沒浪費，在一場對抗必至之戰的無情軍備競賽之後，停戰協定破裂的那一刻，你已經準備好放出地獄。
gear-armour#0019.flat: Only the naive celebrate a ceasefire. Not a second wasted, a merciless arms race against the inevitability of war has left you ready to unleash hell the moment the armistice breaks.

gear-armour#0020.src: Just because it's been said to death doesn't mean it isn't true.
gear-armour#0020.dst: 一句話被講到爛，不代表它就不是真的。
gear-armour#0020.flat: Just because it's been said to death doesn't mean it isn't true.

gear-armour#0021.src: This dark relic was found at the very bottom of the deepest trench of the ocean. It drains all light surrounding it, blinding everything in a strange abyssal darkness.
gear-armour#0021.dst: 這件黑暗遺物是在海洋最深海溝的底部找到的。它會吸乾周遭所有的光，讓一切陷入一種詭異的深淵黑暗之中。
gear-armour#0021.flat: This dark relic was found at the very bottom of the deepest trench of the ocean. It drains all light surrounding it, blinding everything in a strange abyssal darkness.

gear-armour#0022.src: "The symbol of the river" is a name that is often synonymous with this garment, with many water like qualities surrounding it, heavily bathed in magical meaning.
gear-armour#0022.dst: 「河流的象徵」——這件衣物常被冠上這個名字，周身環繞著種種近似水的特質，滿載著魔法上的意涵。
gear-armour#0022.flat: "The symbol of the river" is a name that is often synonymous with this garment, with many water like qualities surrounding it, heavily bathed in magical meaning.

gear-armour#0023.src: Long strips of chitin discarded from the mother of spiders Arakadicus still contain traces of her wicked powers, but few have survived the attempts to harvest them.
gear-armour#0023.dst: 從蜘蛛之母 Arakadicus 身上蛻下的長條甲殼，至今仍留有牠邪惡力量的痕跡；但試圖採集的人，活下來的沒幾個。
gear-armour#0023.flat: Long strips of chitin discarded from the mother of spiders Arakadicus still contain traces of her wicked powers, but few have survived the attempts to harvest them.

gear-armour#0024.src: An age of inundation. To overwhelm a vicious hell with immense waves, and protest the hand of fate. To harbor the beginning of life, and nurture a world of growth. From the fire, we are born.
gear-armour#0024.dst: 一個洪泛的紀元。以滔天巨浪淹沒凶暴的地獄，向命運之手抗議。孕育生命的開端，養育一個生長的世界。我們自烈火之中誕生。
gear-armour#0024.flat: An age of inundation. To overwhelm a vicious hell with immense waves, and protest the hand of fate. To harbor the beginning of life, and nurture a world of growth. From the fire, we are born.

gear-armour#0025.src: Two iron horns adorn this helmet to enhance the warriors of the Eradian, Dwarves who specifically rode Rams into battle at incredible speed.
gear-armour#0025.dst: 兩支鐵角裝在這頂頭盔上，用來強化 Eradian 戰士——那是一支專門騎公羊、以驚人速度衝鋒陷陣的矮人。
gear-armour#0025.flat: Two iron horns adorn this helmet to enhance the warriors of the Eradian, Dwarves who specifically rode Rams into battle at incredible speed.

gear-armour#0026.src: I am thou... Thou art I.
gear-armour#0026.flat: I am thou... Thou art I.

gear-armour#0027.src: A condition of severely deficient supply of oxygen to the body that arises from abnormal breathing; practitioners that abuse specific magic combos are often found incapacitated by said condition.
gear-armour#0027.dst: 一種因呼吸異常而導致身體嚴重缺氧的狀態；濫用特定法術連段的施術者，經常被人發現因這種狀況而失去行動能力。
gear-armour#0027.flat: A condition of severely deficient supply of oxygen to the body that arises from abnormal breathing; practitioners that abuse specific magic combos are often found incapacitated by said condition.

gear-armour#0028.src: The parting gift of a condemned lover: a mesh of starstuff, bound with hope. A reminder that the heavens will always guide you home. A forgiveness. This parcel never reached its destination.
gear-armour#0028.dst: 一位被判罪的戀人所留下的臨別贈禮：一襲以希望繫成的星塵之網。它提醒著你，諸天永遠會指引你回家。一份寬恕。這個包裹從未送達它的目的地。
gear-armour#0028.flat: The parting gift of a condemned lover: a mesh of starstuff, bound with hope. A reminder that the heavens will always guide you home. A forgiveness. This parcel never reached its destination.

gear-armour#0030.src: A powerful mental curse surrounds these boots, inciting uncontrollable rage into the wearers, as well as the power to enact it upon others.
gear-armour#0030.dst: 一道強大的心靈詛咒纏繞著這雙靴子，在穿戴者心中煽起無法控制的暴怒，並賦予他將之施加於他人的力量。
gear-armour#0030.flat: A powerful mental curse surrounds these boots, inciting uncontrollable rage into the wearers, as well as the power to enact it upon others.

gear-armour#0031.src: Double vision reshapes the moon's halo into the irises of an angel - radiant in their delicate, celestial beauty. Astigmatic lights sharpen into heavenly blades and you are the martyr to wield them.
gear-armour#0031.dst: 重影把月暈重塑成天使的虹膜——在那纖細而神聖的美裡熠熠生輝。散光的光點銳化成天上的刃，而你，是揮舞它們的殉道者。
gear-armour#0031.flat: Double vision reshapes the moon's halo into the irises of an angel - radiant in their delicate, celestial beauty. Astigmatic lights sharpen into heavenly blades and you are the martyr to wield them.

gear-armour#0032.src: Wouldn't it be nice to just let go and let something else take the wheel every now and then?
gear-armour#0032.dst: 偶爾就這樣放手，讓別的什麼來掌舵，不是也挺好的嗎？
gear-armour#0032.flat: Wouldn't it be nice to just let go and let something else take the wheel every now and then?

gear-armour#0033.src: All legends must one day fall, but their legacy shall be remembered forevermore.  These memories exist in the hearts of all,  and pave the path forward in hopes to create a world where all may find peace,  however rocky that path may be.
gear-armour#0033.dst: 所有傳說終有一天會殞落，但它們留下的東西將永遠被記得。那些記憶存在於每一個人的心裡，鋪出向前的道路，盼望能造就一個人人皆得安寧的世界——縱使那條路再怎麼崎嶇。
gear-armour#0033.flat: All legends must one day fall, but their legacy shall be remembered forevermore.  These memories exist in the hearts of all,  and pave the path forward in hopes to create a world where all may find peace,  however rocky that path may be.

gear-armour#0034.src: The runic message carved on these enigmatic boots cover hundreds of different languages, many of them disused, but what has been translated seems to describe a disaster soon to arrive to the world.
gear-armour#0034.dst: 這雙神祕靴子上刻著的符文訊息橫跨數百種不同語言，其中許多已經失傳；而已被譯出的部分，似乎在描述一場即將降臨於世的災難。
gear-armour#0034.flat: The runic message carved on these enigmatic boots cover hundreds of different languages, many of them disused, but what has been translated seems to describe a disaster soon to arrive to the world.

gear-armour#0035.src: Whipping, chilling winds, and circling hailstones the size of boulders-the eye of your storm is the only safe place to be.
gear-armour#0035.dst: 狂抽的寒風，以及繞著打轉、大如巨石的冰雹——你這場風暴的風眼，是唯一安全的地方。
gear-armour#0035.flat: Whipping, chilling winds, and circling hailstones the size of boulders-the eye of your storm is the only safe place to be.

gear-armour#0036.src: Your wit picked bare, the raw burn of reality exposing your fresh warped self to the world. Your abilities magnified, a new power ripping free from under your skin. You have traded your mind for something far, far greater.
gear-armour#0036.dst: 你的智識被剝得精光，現實那股赤裸的灼燒把你嶄新扭曲的自己攤在世人面前。你的能力被放大，一股新的力量從你皮膚底下撕裂而出。你用自己的心智，換來了某種遠遠更為龐大的東西。
gear-armour#0036.flat: Your wit picked bare, the raw burn of reality exposing your fresh warped self to the world. Your abilities magnified, a new power ripping free from under your skin. You have traded your mind for something far, far greater.

gear-armour#0037.src: The sweater has the quote "All STOCKINGED up for the season" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0037.dst: 毛衣正面織著一句話：「All STOCKINGED up for the season」——這一季的襪子(與存貨)都備齊了。
gear-armour#0037.flat: The sweater has the quote "All STOCKINGED up for the season" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0038.src: "The skeletons at {p} are rotted! is it even physically possible to rot a bone?" -Laen, {p} Librarian
gear-armour#0038.dst: 「{p} 的骷髏都爛掉了！骨頭在物理上真的有辦法爛嗎？」—Laen，{p} 圖書館員
gear-armour#0038.flat: "The skeletons at {p} are rotted! is it even physically possible to rot a bone?" -Laen, {p} Librarian
gear-armour#0038._raw: "The skeletons at Ancient Nemract are rotted! is it even physically possible to rot a bone?" -Laen, Nemract Librarian

gear-armour#0039.src: The sweater has the quote "Prepare for a FLURRY of Craftmas spirit" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0039.dst: 毛衣正面織著一句話：「Prepare for a FLURRY of Craftmas spirit」——準備迎接一陣(雪花般的)Craftmas 熱潮。
gear-armour#0039.flat: The sweater has the quote "Prepare for a FLURRY of Craftmas spirit" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0040.src: In the marbling of wood grain. Drying moisture in the cobbles. Clumps of flowers. Tree bark, birth marks, the pattern of this plate - unflinching faces trapped, now revealed. The question pierces your mind: what shape will I be hewn into, one day?
gear-armour#0040.dst: 在木紋的雲石花紋裡。在鵝卵石上正在乾涸的水氣裡。在成叢的花裡。樹皮、胎記、這片甲板上的紋路——那些被困住的、不曾眨眼的臉，如今顯露出來。一個問題刺穿你的腦海：有一天，我又會被鑿成什麼形狀？
gear-armour#0040.flat: In the marbling of wood grain. Drying moisture in the cobbles. Clumps of flowers. Tree bark, birth marks, the pattern of this plate - unflinching faces trapped, now revealed. The question pierces your mind: what shape will I be hewn into, one day?

gear-armour#0041.src: The thick, Bovemist-sanctified cloth is worn by their priests during certain religious ceremonies. It clears the mind and purifies the body.
gear-armour#0041.dst: 這塊厚實、經 Bovemist 祝聖過的布料，是他們的祭司在特定宗教儀式上所穿。它能澄澈心神、淨化身體。
gear-armour#0041.flat: The thick, Bovemist-sanctified cloth is worn by their priests during certain religious ceremonies. It clears the mind and purifies the body.

gear-armour#0042.src: Imbued with the blood of the first werewolf, it was kept in {p} as a trophy before being stolen. Wearing it is said to mimic the effects of the lycanthropic curse.
gear-armour#0042.dst: 灌注了第一頭狼人的血，它曾作為戰利品保存在 {p}，後來被偷走。據說戴上它會模擬出狼人詛咒的效果。
gear-armour#0042.flat: Imbued with the blood of the first werewolf, it was kept in {p} as a trophy before being stolen. Wearing it is said to mimic the effects of the lycanthropic curse.
gear-armour#0042._raw: Imbued with the blood of the first werewolf, it was kept in Gelibord as a trophy before being stolen. Wearing it is said to mimic the effects of the lycanthropic curse.

gear-armour#0043.src: The Blue Mask's physical traits are equal to that of paper, but the mystical properties enhance the wearers personal skills tenfold. The mask is thought to originate from an ancient Dernel tribe.
gear-armour#0043.dst: 藍面具的物理強度跟一張紙沒兩樣，但它的神祕力量能把配戴者的個人能力提升十倍。一般認為這面具源自一支古老的 Dernel 部族。
gear-armour#0043.flat: The Blue Mask's physical traits are equal to that of paper, but the mystical properties enhance the wearers personal skills tenfold. The mask is thought to originate from an ancient Dernel tribe.

gear-armour#0044.src: The sweater has the quote "Don't feel BLUE- It's Craftmas!" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0044.dst: 毛衣正面織著一句話：「Don't feel BLUE- It's Craftmas!」——別憂鬱(別藍)，這可是 Craftmas！
gear-armour#0044.flat: The sweater has the quote "Don't feel BLUE- It's Craftmas!" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0045.src: This battered chestplate was once worn by the legendary Wynnic protector, Bob, during the fearsome corrupted sieges before he gave it away to an old friend. An air of melancholy hangs over it.
gear-armour#0045.dst: 這件殘破的胸甲，曾由傳說中的 Wynn 守護者 Bob 在那些可怖的腐敗圍城中穿著，後來他把它送給了一位老友。一股哀傷的氣息縈繞其上。
gear-armour#0045.flat: This battered chestplate was once worn by the legendary Wynnic protector, Bob, during the fearsome corrupted sieges before he gave it away to an old friend. An air of melancholy hangs over it.

gear-armour#0046.src: A marvel of Corkus' electromagical advancements, this high-tech chestplate is equipped with steam jets to boost the user's speed, at a minimal cost to protection.
gear-armour#0046.dst: Corkus 電魔法進展的一項傑作，這件高科技胸甲配備蒸氣噴嘴以提升使用者的速度，而防護力只需付出極小的代價。
gear-armour#0046.flat: A marvel of Corkus' electromagical advancements, this high-tech chestplate is equipped with steam jets to boost the user's speed, at a minimal cost to protection.

gear-armour#0047.src: Engraved with the beauty and mystery of the boreal lights, this ornately-crafted crown is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0047.dst: 鏤刻著北方極光的美麗與神祕，這頂工藝精緻的冠冕，只授予擊敗過蜂巢女主人的人。
gear-armour#0047.flat: Engraved with the beauty and mystery of the boreal lights, this ornately-crafted crown is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0048.src: The last known crafts of Theorick before his fall in battle were pieces of armour crafted out of pure ice, all of which have melted save for these shimmering boots. The coldest gales and most suffocating heat nurture and repair the wearer instead of being stifling or deadly.
gear-armour#0048.dst: Theorick 在戰死之前留下的最後幾件作品，是以純冰打造的鎧甲；除了這雙閃著微光的靴子之外，其餘都已融化。最刺骨的寒風與最窒悶的酷熱，對穿著它的人不但不再難耐或致命，反而成了滋養與修復。
gear-armour#0048.flat: The last known crafts of Theorick before his fall in battle were pieces of armour crafted out of pure ice, all of which have melted save for these shimmering boots. The coldest gales and most suffocating heat nurture and repair the wearer instead of being stifling or deadly.

gear-armour#0049.src: This helmet was worn long ago by an infamous assassin who plagued Bovemist sites for decades. It was crafted of the still-bloody skin of their most prized and worshiped cows.
gear-armour#0049.dst: 這頂頭盔在很久以前屬於一名惡名昭彰的刺客，他侵擾 Bovemist 的聖地長達數十年。它是用他們最珍視、最受崇敬的那頭牛尚在滴血的皮所製成。
gear-armour#0049.flat: This helmet was worn long ago by an infamous assassin who plagued Bovemist sites for decades. It was crafted of the still-bloody skin of their most prized and worshiped cows.

gear-armour#0050.src: An otherwise healthy soldier once writhed and collapsed in the confines of an outpost. His autopsy was quickly canceled when military doctors noticed an unusually rapid spread of corruption in his corpse.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0050.dst: 一名原本健康的士兵，曾在哨站裡痙攣倒地。軍醫注意到他屍體上的腐敗擴散得異常迅速，驗屍隨即被取消。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
gear-armour#0050.flat: An otherwise healthy soldier once writhed and collapsed in the confines of an outpost. His autopsy was quickly canceled when military doctors noticed an unusually rapid spread of corruption in his corpse.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0051.src: These leggings hold the interest of many researching the corruption, as they are the only documented case of a non-corrupt fusion of dark and light energy, made of pure twilight.
gear-armour#0051.dst: 這條護腿吸引了許多研究腐敗的人注意，因為它是唯一有紀錄的、暗與光的能量未經腐敗而融合的案例——由純粹的暮光所構成。
gear-armour#0051.flat: These leggings hold the interest of many researching the corruption, as they are the only documented case of a non-corrupt fusion of dark and light energy, made of pure twilight.

gear-armour#0052.src: "With the hot, dry winds from the Roots and the cold, wet winds from {p}, these houses rot faster than you can blink." -Viraex, {p} Citizen
gear-armour#0052.dst: 「Roots 那邊吹來乾熱的風，{p} 那邊吹來濕冷的風，這些房子爛得比你眨眼還快。」—Viraex，{p} 居民
gear-armour#0052.flat: "With the hot, dry winds from the Roots and the cold, wet winds from {p}, these houses rot faster than you can blink." -Viraex, {p} Citizen
gear-armour#0052._raw: "With the hot, dry winds from the Roots and the cold, wet winds from Nesaak, these houses rot faster than you can blink." -Viraex, Elkurn Citizen

gear-armour#0053.src: Torn scraps of metal line the inside of these boots. They provide no protection, instead forcing a constant adrenaline rush while worn.
gear-armour#0053.dst: 這雙靴子內襯滿是撕裂的金屬碎片。它們提供不了任何防護，反而讓穿戴者持續處於腎上腺素飆升的狀態。
gear-armour#0053.flat: Torn scraps of metal line the inside of these boots. They provide no protection, instead forcing a constant adrenaline rush while worn.

gear-armour#0054.src: The sweater has the quote "YULE see me smiling this season" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0054.dst: 毛衣正面織著一句話：「YULE see me smiling this season」——這一季你會看到我在笑(YULE 即耶節)。
gear-armour#0054.flat: The sweater has the quote "YULE see me smiling this season" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0055.src: These are congealed and rather gross, but they leave you with an undeniable bounce in your step.
gear-armour#0055.dst: 這雙鞋黏糊糊的，還挺噁心，但它們確實讓你的步伐彈了起來。
gear-armour#0055.flat: These are congealed and rather gross, but they leave you with an undeniable bounce in your step.

gear-armour#0056.src: "Time travel cares less about small things like a flapping wing, and more about big things, like becoming your own grandfather." -Martyn, {p} Resident
gear-armour#0056.dst: 「時間旅行不太在意翅膀拍動這種小事，它在意的是大事——比如你變成了自己的祖父。」—Martyn，{p} 居民
gear-armour#0056.flat: "Time travel cares less about small things like a flapping wing, and more about big things, like becoming your own grandfather." -Martyn, {p} Resident
gear-armour#0056._raw: "Time travel cares less about small things like a flapping wing, and more about big things, like becoming your own grandfather." -Martyn, Time Valley Resident

gear-armour#0057.src: The ancient bones of the demon Garaheth are stronger than steel. They clamp down when worn to constrict the bearer, inciting a slow madness.
gear-armour#0057.dst: 惡魔 Garaheth 的遠古骨骸比鋼還堅硬。穿戴時它們會夾緊、束縛住持有者，慢慢煽起一股瘋狂。
gear-armour#0057.flat: The ancient bones of the demon Garaheth are stronger than steel. They clamp down when worn to constrict the bearer, inciting a slow madness.

gear-armour#0058.src: Originating from the unspeakable dark land, looking into the helmet will show nothing but darkness. Wearing it is said to reverse your morality, as if it were draining your will to live into the void.
gear-armour#0058.dst: 源自那片不可名狀的黑暗之地，往這頂頭盔裡看，除了黑暗什麼也看不到。據說戴上它會顛倒你的是非觀，彷彿正把你求生的意志抽進虛空之中。
gear-armour#0058.flat: Originating from the unspeakable dark land, looking into the helmet will show nothing but darkness. Wearing it is said to reverse your morality, as if it were draining your will to live into the void.

gear-armour#0059.src: An impenetrable fortress' greatest strength is psychological, a mythos built on the backs of a thousand attackers it has withstood. Your greatest strength is the belief that not one of those thousand could hold a candle to you.
gear-armour#0059.dst: 一座無法攻破的堡壘，最大的力量其實在心理層面——那是建立在它擋下的上千名攻擊者背上的一則神話。而你最大的力量，是相信那上千人當中沒有一個比得上你。
gear-armour#0059.flat: An impenetrable fortress' greatest strength is psychological, a mythos built on the backs of a thousand attackers it has withstood. Your greatest strength is the belief that not one of those thousand could hold a candle to you.

gear-armour#0060.src: During a spiritual journey to Kato temple, the sage Capian was presented with powerful spiritual boots with the intention to be used for peaceful magic, and not hard combat.
gear-armour#0060.dst: 在一趟前往 Kato 神殿的靈性之旅中，賢者 Capian 獲贈了一雙強大的靈性靴子；其用意是用於平和的魔法，而非激烈的戰鬥。
gear-armour#0060.flat: During a spiritual journey to Kato temple, the sage Capian was presented with powerful spiritual boots with the intention to be used for peaceful magic, and not hard combat.

gear-armour#0061.src: You awake in a cold sweat, finding yourself in control of two more arms and a hard exterior. You cannot make any sense of what is happening inside yourself. You cannot even explain it to yourself. How about you sleep a little bit longer and forget all this nonsense?
gear-armour#0061.dst: 你在一身冷汗中醒來，發現自己多了兩隻手臂，還有一副堅硬的外殼。你完全搞不懂自己體內發生了什麼事。你連對自己解釋都做不到。不如再多睡一會兒，把這些荒唐事全忘了吧？
gear-armour#0061.flat: You awake in a cold sweat, finding yourself in control of two more arms and a hard exterior. You cannot make any sense of what is happening inside yourself. You cannot even explain it to yourself. How about you sleep a little bit longer and forget all this nonsense?

gear-armour#0062.src: Ancient scholars claim the malevolent fungus within its plates feeds on the host's life force, granting unspeakable toxic power in return. Yet every wearer risks wasting away from the inside out.
gear-armour#0062.dst: 古代學者聲稱，甲片之中的惡性真菌以宿主的生命力為食，回報以難以言喻的毒性力量。然而每一位穿戴者，都冒著從體內開始被掏空的風險。
gear-armour#0062.flat: Ancient scholars claim the malevolent fungus within its plates feeds on the host's life force, granting unspeakable toxic power in return. Yet every wearer risks wasting away from the inside out.

gear-armour#0063.src: ...As the heart fails, adrenaline pumps through the body in an attempt to provide energy and keep the victim alive, but medical action must be taken to ensure survival. -Excerpt from {p} Medical Tomes, Vol. {~}
gear-armour#0063.dst: ……當心臟衰竭時，腎上腺素會泵遍全身，試圖提供能量以維持患者的生命；但仍必須採取醫療處置才能確保存活。—節錄自 {p} 醫典，第 {~} 卷
gear-armour#0063.flat: ...As the heart fails, adrenaline pumps through the body in an attempt to provide energy and keep the victim alive, but medical action must be taken to ensure survival. -Excerpt from {p} Medical Tomes, Vol. {~}
gear-armour#0063._raw: ...As the heart fails, adrenaline pumps through the body in an attempt to provide energy and keep the victim alive, but medical action must be taken to ensure survival. -Excerpt from Aldorei Medical Tomes, Vol. 6

gear-armour#0064.src: Soldiers training in extreme cold conditions often push themselves beyond the limits. This however is not sustainable, as their bodies frantically scramble for survival.
gear-armour#0064.dst: 在極寒條件下訓練的士兵常常會把自己逼過極限。然而這是撐不久的——他們的身體會開始為了活下去而慌亂地自我拆解。
gear-armour#0064.flat: Soldiers training in extreme cold conditions often push themselves beyond the limits. This however is not sustainable, as their bodies frantically scramble for survival.

gear-armour#0065.src: "...Most of their vital organs, however, are located in the bulbous abdomen. If you've enough crushing force with your weapon, it may be a quicker alternative for the kill. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter {~}
gear-armour#0065.dst: 「……不過牠們大部分的重要器官都位於膨大的腹部。如果你的武器打擊力夠強，那或許是比較快的解決方式。……」—Admiral Aegis 的 Nivla 威脅指南，第 {~} 章
gear-armour#0065.flat: "...Most of their vital organs, however, are located in the bulbous abdomen. If you've enough crushing force with your weapon, it may be a quicker alternative for the kill. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter {~}
gear-armour#0065._raw: "...Most of their vital organs, however, are located in the bulbous abdomen. If you've enough crushing force with your weapon, it may be a quicker alternative for the kill. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

gear-armour#0066.src: One of the master tinkerer Cerid's greatest inventions, these odd gear-laced boots clink and chime with the sound of clockworks keeping its powerful magic dynamos constantly running.
gear-armour#0066.dst: 巧匠大師 Cerid 最偉大的發明之一；這雙嵌滿齒輪的怪靴會發出鐘錶般的叮噹聲，讓它強大的魔力發電機持續運轉。
gear-armour#0066.flat: One of the master tinkerer Cerid's greatest inventions, these odd gear-laced boots clink and chime with the sound of clockworks keeping its powerful magic dynamos constantly running.

gear-armour#0067.src: The sweater has the quote "SLOPE to SKI you again next Craftmas" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0067.dst: 毛衣正面織著一句話：「SLOPE to SKI you again next Craftmas」——希望(滑雪道上)明年 Craftmas 再見。
gear-armour#0067.flat: The sweater has the quote "SLOPE to SKI you again next Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0069.src: Materials of all sorts have been lashed together in this crude, blocky set of leggings. From darksteel to leather to rotting wood, each part is a perfect square. It has, so far, been impossible to recreate.
gear-armour#0069.dst: 各式各樣的材料被硬綁在一起，構成這副粗糙而方塊化的護腿。從暗鋼到皮革再到腐朽的木頭，每一塊都是完美的正方形。至今為止，沒有人能複製出第二件。
gear-armour#0069.flat: Materials of all sorts have been lashed together in this crude, blocky set of leggings. From darksteel to leather to rotting wood, each part is a perfect square. It has, so far, been impossible to recreate.

gear-armour#0070.src: These leggings were forged in honour of a martyr, who, legend has it, fought off a horde of the marauders for two days without food or rest to defend his village.
gear-armour#0070.dst: 這副護腿是為紀念一位殉道者而鍛。傳說他為了守護自己的村子，不吃不睡連續兩天擊退了一整群掠奪者。
gear-armour#0070.flat: These leggings were forged in honour of a martyr, who, legend has it, fought off a horde of the marauders for two days without food or rest to defend his village.

gear-armour#0071.src: With threads of fundamentally opposing magic delicately woven together, these ornately-crafted greaves are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0071.dst: 以根本相互對立的魔法絲線細膩交織而成，這副工藝精緻的脛甲，只授予擊敗過蜂巢女主人的人。
gear-armour#0071.flat: With threads of fundamentally opposing magic delicately woven together, these ornately-crafted greaves are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0072.src: The one true Chimera in existence is sought by many, for great stories are told of its gifts to the worthy. One such gift was a simple fur coat, which gave the wearer but a taste of its power.
gear-armour#0072.dst: 世上唯一真正的奇美拉為許多人所追尋，因為傳說它會賜福給值得的人。其中一份禮物是一件樸素的毛皮外衣，只讓穿戴者嘗到牠力量的一點皮毛。
gear-armour#0072.flat: The one true Chimera in existence is sought by many, for great stories are told of its gifts to the worthy. One such gift was a simple fur coat, which gave the wearer but a taste of its power.

gear-armour#0073.src: The shirt has the quote "I went to the {p} in {p} and all I got was this lousy T-shirt" printed on it.
gear-armour#0073.dst: 衣服上印著一句話：「我去了 {p} 的 {p}，結果只買到這件爛 T 恤」。
gear-armour#0073.flat: The shirt has the quote "I went to the {p} in {p} and all I got was this lousy T-shirt" printed on it.
gear-armour#0073._raw: The shirt has the quote "I went to the Letvus Airbase in Cinfras and all I got was this lousy T-shirt" printed on it.

gear-armour#0074.src: Ancient magicks are required to make these brilliant glasses, imbued with charity and selflessness. They allow sight beyond sight, rumoured to allow sight of a brilliant realm.
gear-armour#0074.dst: 要製作這副明亮的眼鏡需要古老的魔法，並灌注慈愛與無私。它們能讓人看見視覺之外的東西，據傳甚至能望見一個燦爛的界域。
gear-armour#0074.flat: Ancient magicks are required to make these brilliant glasses, imbued with charity and selflessness. They allow sight beyond sight, rumoured to allow sight of a brilliant realm.

gear-armour#0075.src: Nothing stands out about these thin greaves at a glance. But sometimes, when the time is right, a tempestuous power rushes through them: your legs moving as by themselves, and taking leaps that they should never be able to.
gear-armour#0075.dst: 乍看之下，這副輕薄的脛甲毫無特出之處。但有時候，時機對了，一股暴烈的力量會竄過它們：你的雙腿彷彿自行移動，跳出它們本來絕不可能做到的高度。
gear-armour#0075.flat: Nothing stands out about these thin greaves at a glance. But sometimes, when the time is right, a tempestuous power rushes through them: your legs moving as by themselves, and taking leaps that they should never be able to.

gear-armour#0076.src: A million stinging needles, tangled around your head; A crown of thorns; A wreath of nematocysts; A chaplet of venom and pain. From that poison cup, you drink and drink, until-Like a jellyfish-Only the currents decide your way. Until only an addictive Hate compels you.
gear-armour#0076.dst: 百萬根螫刺的針，纏繞在你的頭上；一頂荊棘之冠；一圈刺絲胞的花環；一串由毒液與痛楚串成的頭飾。你從那只毒杯裡一飲再飲，直到——像水母一樣——只剩下洋流決定你的去向。直到只剩一份令人上癮的恨在驅使你。
gear-armour#0076.flat: A million stinging needles, tangled around your head; A crown of thorns; A wreath of nematocysts; A chaplet of venom and pain. From that poison cup, you drink and drink, until-Like a jellyfish-Only the currents decide your way. Until only an addictive Hate compels you.

gear-armour#0077.src: Left to brittle introspection, love unrequited stings the most when it brings down something built to last.
gear-armour#0077.dst: 被留在脆薄的自省裡，當愛得不到回應，最刺痛的時刻，莫過於它拆毀了某個本該長久的東西。
gear-armour#0077.flat: Left to brittle introspection, love unrequited stings the most when it brings down something built to last.

gear-armour#0078.src: Using an unorthodox method of smithing, these copper leggings are insulated with an extremely conductive blend of liquid to improve electrical discharge.
gear-armour#0078.dst: 以一種非正統的鍛造方式製成，這副銅製護腿以一種導電性極強的液體作為絕緣層，藉此改善電流放電。
gear-armour#0078.flat: Using an unorthodox method of smithing, these copper leggings are insulated with an extremely conductive blend of liquid to improve electrical discharge.

gear-armour#0079.src: She's taken all you have. Your blood. Your sweat. Your tears. You must repay the debt, no matter the consequences, so that what was stolen will be returned tenfold.
gear-armour#0079.dst: 她拿走了你所有的一切。你的血。你的汗。你的淚。你必須把這筆債還回來，不計後果，好讓被奪走的東西加倍十倍地回到你手上。
gear-armour#0079.flat: She's taken all you have. Your blood. Your sweat. Your tears. You must repay the debt, no matter the consequences, so that what was stolen will be returned tenfold.

gear-armour#0080.src: Donning this helmet sears your mind with images of a world on fire. These blistering thoughts pressure you to make that world a reality.
gear-armour#0080.dst: 戴上這頂頭盔，一幅世界陷入火海的景象會灼進你的腦海。那些滾燙的念頭會逼著你把那個世界化為現實。
gear-armour#0080.flat: Donning this helmet sears your mind with images of a world on fire. These blistering thoughts pressure you to make that world a reality.

gear-armour#0081.src: No reign lasts forever. Not while your schemes remain unnoticed.
gear-armour#0081.dst: 沒有哪個政權能永遠撐下去——只要你的算計還沒被察覺。
gear-armour#0081.flat: No reign lasts forever. Not while your schemes remain unnoticed.

gear-armour#0083.src: A symbol of authority, power, and the right to rule. Let Her leadership burn brightly forevermore, leading us into a new era of strength.
gear-armour#0083.dst: 權威、力量與統治權的象徵。願陛下的領導永遠熠熠生輝，帶領我們走進一個力量的新紀元。
gear-armour#0083.flat: A symbol of authority, power, and the right to rule. Let Her leadership burn brightly forevermore, leading us into a new era of strength.

gear-armour#0084.src: The leaves in this coronet cackle and hiss, a cacophony of malicious intent. They would just as soon shred your enemies to bits as remove your own head from your shoulders.
gear-armour#0084.dst: 這頂葉冠上的葉子會咯咯低笑、嘶嘶作響，是一片惡意的雜音。它們既能把你的敵人撕成碎片，也一樣樂意把你的頭從肩上摘下來。
gear-armour#0084.flat: The leaves in this coronet cackle and hiss, a cacophony of malicious intent. They would just as soon shred your enemies to bits as remove your own head from your shoulders.

gear-armour#0085.src: It always returns a little weaker than what it was before. Perhaps someday, it'll be put down for good.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0085.dst: 它每次回來都比先前弱了一點。也許哪一天，它就會被徹底放下了。它正被某種東西牽引著。
gear-armour#0085.flat: It always returns a little weaker than what it was before. Perhaps someday, it'll be put down for good.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0086.src: One of the very few physically-powerful artifacts of the Villagers, these boots were used in the initial crusades against the Green-skins, to overpower the Orcs via raw physical might. Though effective, they have not seen use in a long time.
gear-armour#0086.dst: 這是村民少數幾件以物理力量見長的遺物之一。這雙靴子曾用於對綠皮的初期遠征，好以純粹的體能壓制獸人。雖然確實有效，但它已經很久沒有派上用場了。
gear-armour#0086.flat: One of the very few physically-powerful artifacts of the Villagers, these boots were used in the initial crusades against the Green-skins, to overpower the Orcs via raw physical might. Though effective, they have not seen use in a long time.

gear-armour#0087.src: Forged on {p}, the sparkling liquid-like armour is as hard as obsidian, but light and fluid as water. It glistens with the magic of the ocean winds.
gear-armour#0087.dst: 鍛造於 {p}，這件閃爍如液體的護甲硬如黑曜石，卻又輕盈流動如水。它閃耀著海風的魔法光澤。
gear-armour#0087.flat: Forged on {p}, the sparkling liquid-like armour is as hard as obsidian, but light and fluid as water. It glistens with the magic of the ocean winds.
gear-armour#0087._raw: Forged on Mage Island, the sparkling liquid-like armour is as hard as obsidian, but light and fluid as water. It glistens with the magic of the ocean winds.

gear-armour#0088.src: A centuries-old storm spirit was banished to these tight boots for his destructive actions. His fury empowers those who wear them with the great force of a raging cyclone.
gear-armour#0088.dst: 一位存在數百年的風暴之靈，因其破壞行徑被放逐進這雙緊繃的靴子裡。他的怒火會以狂暴氣旋般的巨力賦予穿戴者力量。
gear-armour#0088.flat: A centuries-old storm spirit was banished to these tight boots for his destructive actions. His fury empowers those who wear them with the great force of a raging cyclone.

gear-armour#0089.src: "Discernable by its one-second glow, the cypress firefly makes it home amidst the ash of the upper heights, blending in with the fiery landscape." -Delinaed's Guide to Local Species, {~}nd Edition.
gear-armour#0089.dst: 「柏火蟲可由牠一秒一次的發光辨識，牠棲息於高地的火山灰之間，與那片烈焰般的地景融為一體。」—Delinaed 的在地物種指南，第 {~} 版。
gear-armour#0089.flat: "Discernable by its one-second glow, the cypress firefly makes it home amidst the ash of the upper heights, blending in with the fiery landscape." -Delinaed's Guide to Local Species, {~}nd Edition.
gear-armour#0089._raw: "Discernable by its one-second glow, the cypress firefly makes it home amidst the ash of the upper heights, blending in with the fiery landscape." -Delinaed's Guide to Local Species, 2nd Edition.

gear-armour#0090.src: It permeates around you, so subtly, enveloping your very being with a shroud on the cusp of impalpability.  Nothing can affect you now - the incorporeal hiding in plain sight.
gear-armour#0090.dst: 它如此細微地在你周身滲透，用一層近乎觸不可及的紗把你整個存在裹住。現在沒有東西能影響你了——無形之物，就藏在眾目睽睽之下。
gear-armour#0090.flat: It permeates around you, so subtly, enveloping your very being with a shroud on the cusp of impalpability.  Nothing can affect you now - the incorporeal hiding in plain sight.

gear-armour#0091.src: Wearing this deceptively simple shroud causes the user to fade into the shadows, sometimes flickering out of existence for a moment.
gear-armour#0091.dst: 穿上這件看似樸素的裹布，會讓使用者融進陰影，有時甚至會有那麼一瞬間從存在中閃失。
gear-armour#0091.flat: Wearing this deceptively simple shroud causes the user to fade into the shadows, sometimes flickering out of existence for a moment.

gear-armour#0092.src: Despite being only an impure scrap of the normally sturdy blackiron, these heavy leggings still have extreme defensive capabilities.
gear-armour#0092.dst: 雖然只是一塊雜質頗多的黑鐵殘料，這副沉重的護腿依然具備極強的防禦力。
gear-armour#0092.flat: Despite being only an impure scrap of the normally sturdy blackiron, these heavy leggings still have extreme defensive capabilities.

gear-armour#0093.src: Many prophecies foretell of new eras. Most are fabricated or proven false in time. One passed through the Dogun caverns, however, tells of a dawn soon to break, in which the earth shall run red and return to flame. Fanatical sects whisper the coming of a new demonic god.
gear-armour#0093.dst: 許多預言都在講述新紀元的到來，其中大多是杜撰，或終究被證明是假的。但有一則流傳於 Dogun 洞窟之中的預言說：一個黎明即將破曉，屆時大地將流淌赤紅、重歸烈焰。狂熱的教派低聲傳頌著一位新的惡魔之神即將降臨。
gear-armour#0093.flat: Many prophecies foretell of new eras. Most are fabricated or proven false in time. One passed through the Dogun caverns, however, tells of a dawn soon to break, in which the earth shall run red and return to flame. Fanatical sects whisper the coming of a new demonic god.

gear-armour#0094.src: "We get a lot of weirdos coming from Gavel by airship. That plate mail looked unusably ornate!" -Calo, Private Airship Operator
gear-armour#0094.dst: 「從 Gavel 搭飛船過來的怪人可多了。那件板甲華麗到根本不能穿吧！」——Calo，私人飛船駕駛
gear-armour#0094.flat: "We get a lot of weirdos coming from Gavel by airship. That plate mail looked unusably ornate!" -Calo, Private Airship Operator

gear-armour#0095.src: Found in the middle of the {p} desert, these greaves slowly engulf everything around it in flames. The heat of the desert sun has seared it heavily, empowering it with the fury of the Sun.
gear-armour#0095.dst: 在 {p} 沙漠正中央尋獲，這副脛甲會緩緩把周遭一切吞進火焰之中。沙漠烈日的高溫深深灼燒過它，賦予它太陽的狂怒。
gear-armour#0095.flat: Found in the middle of the {p} desert, these greaves slowly engulf everything around it in flames. The heat of the desert sun has seared it heavily, empowering it with the fury of the Sun.
gear-armour#0095._raw: Found in the middle of the Almuj desert, these greaves slowly engulf everything around it in flames. The heat of the desert sun has seared it heavily, empowering it with the fury of the Sun.

gear-armour#0096.src: Watch the clock freeze. The silence before the storm drags like an eternity, so reinforce your gear, steady your restless mind, and brace yourself for the long haul.
gear-armour#0096.dst: 看著時鐘凍結。風暴前的寂靜漫長得像是永恆——所以加固你的裝備、穩住你躁動的心，準備好打一場長仗。
gear-armour#0096.flat: Watch the clock freeze. The silence before the storm drags like an eternity, so reinforce your gear, steady your restless mind, and brace yourself for the long haul.

gear-armour#0097.src: Don't blink. The brightest moments in life slip away in an instant, so etch every memory in your brain, and reach for them when you face your darkest hour.
gear-armour#0097.dst: 別眨眼。人生中最明亮的時刻總在一瞬間溜走——所以把每一段記憶刻進腦海，等你面對最黑暗的時刻時再伸手去取。
gear-armour#0097.flat: Don't blink. The brightest moments in life slip away in an instant, so etch every memory in your brain, and reach for them when you face your darkest hour.

gear-armour#0098.src: Recovered from a corrupted soldier who wore them, it was found dancing instead of attacking those around it. Even after it was killed, it jostled and jerked around like a dancing puppet.
gear-armour#0098.dst: 從一名穿著它的腐敗士兵身上取得。當時發現它不是在攻擊周圍的人，而是在跳舞。就算被殺死之後，它仍像個跳舞的木偶那樣抽動搖擺。
gear-armour#0098.flat: Recovered from a corrupted soldier who wore them, it was found dancing instead of attacking those around it. Even after it was killed, it jostled and jerked around like a dancing puppet.

gear-armour#0099.src: Wealth and riches...but at what cost?
gear-armour#0099.dst: 財富與珍寶……但代價是什麼？
gear-armour#0099.flat: Wealth and riches...but at what cost?

gear-armour#0100.src: An imperfect fit, but you can make a better one.
gear-armour#0100.dst: 不太合身，但你可以做出更好的。
gear-armour#0100.flat: An imperfect fit, but you can make a better one.

gear-armour#0102.src: The sheer bond between Adamastor and Urdar has manifested itself into a physical form due to their duress. Such power is not to be abused...
gear-armour#0102.dst: Adamastor 與 Urdar 之間那份純粹的羈絆，在他們的重壓之下具現成了實體。這樣的力量不該被濫用……
gear-armour#0102.flat: The sheer bond between Adamastor and Urdar has manifested itself into a physical form due to their duress. Such power is not to be abused...

gear-armour#0103.src: Something is lurking-it must be, in the eerie silence that leaves you so utterly alone. And these remains... Are they a reminder of one who didn't stay quiet, or does what lurks in the unknown already know you're here?
gear-armour#0103.dst: 有什麼東西正潛伏著——一定有，就在這片讓你徹底孤立的詭異靜默裡。而這些殘骸……它們是某個不肯保持安靜的人所留下的警告，還是說，潛伏在未知裡的那個東西早就知道你在這裡了？
gear-armour#0103.flat: Something is lurking-it must be, in the eerie silence that leaves you so utterly alone. And these remains... Are they a reminder of one who didn't stay quiet, or does what lurks in the unknown already know you're here?

gear-armour#0104.src: Found at the bottom of a hydrothermal trench, this incredibly dense stone has been warped and shifted into the shape of armor, containing the strength of the Earth, its water, and all of its awe-inspiring heat.
gear-armour#0104.dst: 在一道熱液深溝的底部尋獲，這塊密度驚人的石頭被扭曲、塑成了護甲的形狀，蘊含著大地的力量、大地的水，以及大地一切令人敬畏的熱。
gear-armour#0104.flat: Found at the bottom of a hydrothermal trench, this incredibly dense stone has been warped and shifted into the shape of armor, containing the strength of the Earth, its water, and all of its awe-inspiring heat.

gear-armour#0105.src: "We're trying to dig up history, not horrors! What is wrong with this province?!"  -Excavator Vade, WynnExcavation Site A Director
gear-armour#0105.dst: 「我們是要挖歷史，不是挖恐怖的東西！這個行省到底是怎麼回事？！」——挖掘員 Vade，WynnExcavation A 號工地主任
gear-armour#0105.flat: "We're trying to dig up history, not horrors! What is wrong with this province?!"  -Excavator Vade, WynnExcavation Site A Director

gear-armour#0106.src: The heart of the earth, where the ground blooms beautiful blossoms and life grows untethered.
gear-armour#0106.dst: 大地的心臟，那裡的土地綻放著美麗的花朵，生命毫無束縛地生長。
gear-armour#0106.flat: The heart of the earth, where the ground blooms beautiful blossoms and life grows untethered.

gear-armour#0107.src: Distant wails of a bygone time still chime amidst impossibly tall walls of stone – now nothing more than memories, mere mimics of lonely cries.
gear-armour#0107.dst: 逝去年代的遙遠哀鳴，至今仍在那些高得不合常理的石牆之間迴盪——如今那已不過是記憶，是孤獨哭聲的拙劣模仿。
gear-armour#0107.flat: Distant wails of a bygone time still chime amidst impossibly tall walls of stone – now nothing more than memories, mere mimics of lonely cries.

gear-armour#0108.src: Consecrated by Qira herself with blessings unknown to all but her, these ornately-crafted leggings are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0108.dst: 由 Qira 親自以無人知曉的祝福加持，這副工藝精緻的護腿，只授予擊敗過蜂巢女主人的人。
gear-armour#0108.flat: Consecrated by Qira herself with blessings unknown to all but her, these ornately-crafted leggings are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0109.src: The last stand, a hero's rally, a turning tide-is it a tale of a champion who conquered, or a martyr who inspired? This is your story to tell.
gear-armour#0109.dst: 最後的堅守、英雄的號召、逆轉的戰局——這究竟是一則征服者的故事，還是一則感召眾人的殉道者的故事？這一段由你來說。
gear-armour#0109.flat: The last stand, a hero's rally, a turning tide-is it a tale of a champion who conquered, or a martyr who inspired? This is your story to tell.

gear-armour#0110.src: Dedicated to a place of courage revered by all warriors, this ornately-crafted chestplate is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0110.dst: 獻給一處為所有戰士所敬仰的勇氣之地，這件工藝精緻的胸甲，只授予擊敗過蜂巢女主人的人。
gear-armour#0110.flat: Dedicated to a place of courage revered by all warriors, this ornately-crafted chestplate is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0111.src: Shards of frost and bone, fragments of memories and worlds; it all shatters under your step. The cracks reach deep. Too deep. Your soul rests on thin ice.
gear-armour#0111.dst: 霜與骨的碎片，記憶與世界的殘塊；一切都在你的腳步之下碎裂。那些裂縫延伸得很深。太深了。你的靈魂正踩在薄冰上。
gear-armour#0111.flat: Shards of frost and bone, fragments of memories and worlds; it all shatters under your step. The cracks reach deep. Too deep. Your soul rests on thin ice.

gear-armour#0112.src: Tiny spikes lining the inside of these boots suppress the grey matter in the wearer's brain, enhancing their capabilities and making them capable of murderous and immoral acts while in this trance-like, numbed state.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0112.dst: 這雙靴子內襯的細小尖刺會抑制穿戴者腦中的灰質，在提升其能力的同時，讓他在這種恍惚而麻木的狀態下足以做出殺人與悖德之事。它正被某種東西牽引著。
gear-armour#0112.flat: Tiny spikes lining the inside of these boots suppress the grey matter in the wearer's brain, enhancing their capabilities and making them capable of murderous and immoral acts while in this trance-like, numbed state.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0113.src: The chains comprising the mesh are rusty and old. It looks terrible, especially with the newer metal added on.
gear-armour#0113.dst: 構成網面的鎖鏈又鏽又舊。看起來糟透了，尤其是配上新加的那些金屬之後。
gear-armour#0113.flat: The chains comprising the mesh are rusty and old. It looks terrible, especially with the newer metal added on.

gear-armour#0114.src: Even ignoring the numerous scorches all over, these boots hardly look any better.
gear-armour#0114.dst: 就算不算上滿佈的燒焦痕跡，這雙靴子看起來也沒好到哪去。
gear-armour#0114.flat: Even ignoring the numerous scorches all over, these boots hardly look any better.

gear-armour#0115.src: The merchant insists that the wear and oxidation on the armor "is a feature."
gear-armour#0115.dst: 商人堅稱盔甲上的磨損與氧化「是一種特色」。
gear-armour#0115.flat: The merchant insists that the wear and oxidation on the armor "is a feature."

gear-armour#0116.src: They look extremely bulky and uncomfortable...do they have a right to call it "enhanced"?
gear-armour#0116.dst: 看起來又笨重又不舒服……他們有什麼資格叫它「強化版」？
gear-armour#0116.flat: They look extremely bulky and uncomfortable...do they have a right to call it "enhanced"?

gear-armour#0117.src: The merchant launched into a tirade on how the hardness scale of stones means nothing the instant you saw part of the boots flake off upon being touched.
gear-armour#0117.dst: 你一碰，靴子就掉下一小片；商人隨即開始長篇大論，解釋石頭的硬度表根本一點意義也沒有。
gear-armour#0117.flat: The merchant launched into a tirade on how the hardness scale of stones means nothing the instant you saw part of the boots flake off upon being touched.

gear-armour#0118.src: Looks like it was hastily repainted to match the colors of the mesa. ...but you can see the original greens and browns underneath.
gear-armour#0118.dst: 看起來像是為了配合台地的顏色被匆匆重新上過漆。……不過底下原本的綠色和褐色還是看得出來。
gear-armour#0118.flat: Looks like it was hastily repainted to match the colors of the mesa. ...but you can see the original greens and browns underneath.

gear-armour#0119.src: Apparently, gluing some feathers on top of the decorative armor wings is supposed to allow you to fly- so says the merchant, at least.
gear-armour#0119.dst: 據說在裝飾用的盔甲翅膀上黏幾根羽毛就能讓人飛起來——至少商人是這麼說的。
gear-armour#0119.flat: Apparently, gluing some feathers on top of the decorative armor wings is supposed to allow you to fly- so says the merchant, at least.

gear-armour#0120.src: The psalm tag has been replaced with a custom message from the armorer. What it says about the original owner is better left to the imagination.
gear-armour#0120.dst: 原本的經文標籤被換成了盔甲匠自己寫的一段話。至於那段話透露了原主人的什麼，還是別去想比較好。
gear-armour#0120.flat: The psalm tag has been replaced with a custom message from the armorer. What it says about the original owner is better left to the imagination.

gear-armour#0121.src: They look like at once point they may have been fairly upscale. Now they just look like a metallic mess.
gear-armour#0121.dst: 看得出它一度可能相當高級。現在就只是一團金屬爛攤子。
gear-armour#0121.flat: They look like at once point they may have been fairly upscale. Now they just look like a metallic mess.

gear-armour#0122.src: They added stilts to the leggings, so that they could "live up to the name." The fact you can barely stand in them is neatly avoided when you ask.
gear-armour#0122.dst: 他們在護腿上加了高蹺，好「對得起這個名字」。至於你穿上它幾乎站不穩這件事，一問就被巧妙地跳過了。
gear-armour#0122.flat: They added stilts to the leggings, so that they could "live up to the name." The fact you can barely stand in them is neatly avoided when you ask.

gear-armour#0123.src: The paintjob on the armor is incredibly garish. Who thinks to combine sea green, mud, hot pink, and neon yellow?
gear-armour#0123.dst: 這副盔甲的配色俗豔得驚人。誰會想到把海綠、泥褐、亮粉紅和螢光黃湊在一起？
gear-armour#0123.flat: The paintjob on the armor is incredibly garish. Who thinks to combine sea green, mud, hot pink, and neon yellow?

gear-armour#0124.src: Aside from the added plating, they look more or less intact. Somehow, that doesn't surprise you.
gear-armour#0124.dst: 除了多加的那層甲片之外，它們看起來大致還算完好。不知怎麼的，你一點也不意外。
gear-armour#0124.flat: Aside from the added plating, they look more or less intact. Somehow, that doesn't surprise you.

gear-armour#0125.src: Adding hard metal onto a religious cap seems blasphemous to you. The merchant disagrees.
gear-armour#0125.dst: 在一頂宗教用的帽子上加硬金屬，你覺得根本是褻瀆。商人不同意。
gear-armour#0125.flat: Adding hard metal onto a religious cap seems blasphemous to you. The merchant disagrees.

gear-armour#0126.src: Some of the bones used to make the frame of the boots have crumbled. The merchant refuses to comment.
gear-armour#0126.dst: 構成靴子骨架的骨頭有幾根已經碎了。商人拒絕對此發表評論。
gear-armour#0126.flat: Some of the bones used to make the frame of the boots have crumbled. The merchant refuses to comment.

gear-armour#0127.src: The only difference you can see is that a tacky logo for {p} Armoury has been stenciled onto the top.
gear-armour#0127.dst: 你唯一看得出來的差別，是頂上多印了一個俗氣的 {p} 兵工廠商標。
gear-armour#0127.flat: The only difference you can see is that a tacky logo for {p} Armoury has been stenciled onto the top.
gear-armour#0127._raw: The only difference you can see is that a tacky logo for Rymek Armoury has been stenciled onto the top.

gear-armour#0128.src: Supposedly this chestplate belonged to a legendary paladin. The merchant has no explanation for why there are dozens of them.
gear-armour#0128.dst: 據說這件胸甲曾屬於一位傳奇聖騎士。至於為什麼架上有好幾十件，商人沒有解釋。
gear-armour#0128.flat: Supposedly this chestplate belonged to a legendary paladin. The merchant has no explanation for why there are dozens of them.

gear-armour#0129.src: Recovered from subterranean ash deposits, these timeworn greaves are one of many relics of war buried in combat by an ancient eruption.  Entombed by millennia of rock and soil, the ideologies of the belligerents have been long forgotten: all that remains is their endless desire for absolution.
gear-armour#0129.dst: 從地底的火山灰層中挖出，這副飽經歲月的脛甲，是眾多在戰鬥中被一場遠古噴發就地掩埋的戰爭遺物之一。被千年的岩層與土壤封存之後，交戰雙方的理念早已被遺忘：留下來的只有他們對赦免那份無止盡的渴望。
gear-armour#0129.flat: Recovered from subterranean ash deposits, these timeworn greaves are one of many relics of war buried in combat by an ancient eruption.  Entombed by millennia of rock and soil, the ideologies of the belligerents have been long forgotten: all that remains is their endless desire for absolution.

gear-armour#0130.src: A pair of glowing sabatons crafted from time-lost relics. Somehow, despite just creating them, you get the feeling that you've worn these before...
gear-armour#0130.dst: 一雙以失落於時間的遺物打造而成的發光戰靴。不知為何，明明才剛把它們做出來，你卻覺得自己以前穿過……
gear-armour#0130.flat: A pair of glowing sabatons crafted from time-lost relics. Somehow, despite just creating them, you get the feeling that you've worn these before...

gear-armour#0131.src: Perennial, in a sense-these plants cycle through a unique bloom for every season. When they fully form, the breathtaking equinox is said to shine with an otherworldly light.
gear-armour#0131.dst: 某種意義上算是多年生——這些植物每一季都會循環出一次獨特的綻放。據說當它們完全成形時，那令人屏息的分點之花會發出異界般的光。
gear-armour#0131.flat: Perennial, in a sense-these plants cycle through a unique bloom for every season. When they fully form, the breathtaking equinox is said to shine with an otherworldly light.

gear-armour#0132.src: Abandoned by the dwarven Ramriders in their heyday, this hefty armor forged to protect a steed sees little use but littering the steppes of the upper heights. A memento of a slaughter, in days long past.
gear-armour#0132.dst: 在矮人 Ramrider 全盛時期被棄置，這副為保護坐騎而鍛的沉重護甲，如今除了散落在高地的草原上之外幾乎沒有用途。那是很久以前一場屠殺留下的紀念品。
gear-armour#0132.flat: Abandoned by the dwarven Ramriders in their heyday, this hefty armor forged to protect a steed sees little use but littering the steppes of the upper heights. A memento of a slaughter, in days long past.

gear-armour#0133.src: The blind prophet who crafted this macabre breastplate used the bones of only the most ruthless justiciars and executioners. Its wearers are supposedly destined to only die either a heroic or a just death.
gear-armour#0133.dst: 打造這件駭人胸甲的盲眼先知，只用最冷酷的法官與劊子手的骨頭。據說它的穿戴者註定只會死於英雄之死，或死於正義之死。
gear-armour#0133.flat: The blind prophet who crafted this macabre breastplate used the bones of only the most ruthless justiciars and executioners. Its wearers are supposedly destined to only die either a heroic or a just death.

gear-armour#0134.src: This decorative mask, crafted of bronze alloys, is awarded only to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.
gear-armour#0134.dst: 這面以青銅合金製成的裝飾面具，只頒發給那些為了完成傳奇挑戰而投入了不必要之多時間的人。
ctx: armour/Esteemed Bronze Mask of Legendary Victory/lore
gear-armour#0134.flat: This decorative mask, crafted of bronze alloys, is awarded only to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

gear-armour#0135.src: Despite the absence of natural light, in the deepest reaches of the Void grows foliage and flora capable of sustaining itself by absorbing latent energy. Such an accomplishment is to be admired, ideally from a keen distance.
gear-armour#0135.dst: 儘管完全沒有自然光，虛空最深處仍生長著能靠吸收潛藏能量自給自足的枝葉花草。這樣的成就值得敬佩——最好是隔著一段警覺的距離。
gear-armour#0135.flat: Despite the absence of natural light, in the deepest reaches of the Void grows foliage and flora capable of sustaining itself by absorbing latent energy. Such an accomplishment is to be admired, ideally from a keen distance.

gear-armour#0136.src: Without your god, whom else is there to turn to but me?
gear-armour#0136.dst: 沒有了你的神，除了我，你還能轉向誰呢？
gear-armour#0136.flat: Without your god, whom else is there to turn to but me?

gear-armour#0137.src: This matted tangle of vines and marshland plants contains various herbal remedies woven into it. It is oddly comfortable, despite the thorns coating the inside.
gear-armour#0137.dst: 這團糾結的藤蔓與沼澤植物裡編進了各種草藥療方。雖然內側佈滿了荊棘，戴起來卻出奇地舒服。
gear-armour#0137.flat: This matted tangle of vines and marshland plants contains various herbal remedies woven into it. It is oddly comfortable, despite the thorns coating the inside.

gear-armour#0138.src: You have seen the worst the world has to offer, and met it with a cold, determined gaze. You kill for those who cannot defend themselves. The battle is everlasting, but you are a durable soldier. Push through; for honour, for glory, for truth.
gear-armour#0138.dst: 你見過這個世界所能給出最糟的東西，並以冷靜而堅定的目光迎向它。你為那些無力自保的人而殺。這場仗永無止盡，但你是個耐得住的士兵。撐下去；為了榮譽，為了榮耀，為了真相。
gear-armour#0138.flat: You have seen the worst the world has to offer, and met it with a cold, determined gaze. You kill for those who cannot defend themselves. The battle is everlasting, but you are a durable soldier. Push through; for honour, for glory, for truth.

gear-armour#0139.src: You have gotten tired of the abyss staring back. Embrace it in a finale that leaves no survivors.
gear-armour#0139.dst: 你已經厭倦了深淵回望你。用一場不留活口的終曲擁抱它吧。
gear-armour#0139.flat: You have gotten tired of the abyss staring back. Embrace it in a finale that leaves no survivors.

gear-armour#0140.src: The house of the flames, where the sky runs red with rage and passion burns through every soul.
gear-armour#0140.dst: 烈焰之家，那裡的天空因憤怒而赤紅，激情灼燒著每一個靈魂。
gear-armour#0140.flat: The house of the flames, where the sky runs red with rage and passion burns through every soul.

gear-armour#0141.src: From the ashes, let a hero rise anew.
gear-armour#0141.dst: 從灰燼之中，讓英雄再度崛起。
gear-armour#0141.flat: From the ashes, let a hero rise anew.

gear-armour#0142.src: Some places must be protected at all costs. In a frigid, worldwide desert of apathy and ruination, there somehow still remain some oases of love and warmth. Keep them safe, as long as you can.
gear-armour#0142.dst: 有些地方必須不計代價守住。在一片冰冷而遍及全世界的冷漠與荒毀之中，不知怎麼地仍留著幾處愛與溫暖的綠洲。守著它們，能守多久就守多久。
gear-armour#0142.flat: Some places must be protected at all costs. In a frigid, worldwide desert of apathy and ruination, there somehow still remain some oases of love and warmth. Keep them safe, as long as you can.

gear-armour#0143.src: Is it bravery or stupidity that compels you to stare into the jaws of death once more?
gear-armour#0143.dst: 再一次直視死亡的血口，驅使你的究竟是勇氣，還是愚蠢？
gear-armour#0143.flat: Is it bravery or stupidity that compels you to stare into the jaws of death once more?

gear-armour#0144.src: The enemy of your enemy is your friend. It's naught but a ceasefire of convenience, if not necessity, yet it's a chance to lick your wounds and focus your might against the threat at hand.
gear-armour#0144.dst: 敵人的敵人就是朋友。這不過是一場出於方便、甚至出於必要的停火；但它仍是個機會，讓你舔舐傷口，把全部力氣集中到眼前的威脅上。
gear-armour#0144.flat: The enemy of your enemy is your friend. It's naught but a ceasefire of convenience, if not necessity, yet it's a chance to lick your wounds and focus your might against the threat at hand.

gear-armour#0145.src: Crystalline towers and stark white horizons. The sharpest frost shards and the softest snowfall. Before the permafrost monarch of winter, lay your heart down: become the right hand of the cold.
gear-armour#0145.dst: 晶簇般的高塔與純白蕭索的地平線。最鋒利的霜刺與最柔軟的落雪。在那位永凍的寒冬君主面前放下你的心：成為嚴寒的右手。
gear-armour#0145.flat: Crystalline towers and stark white horizons. The sharpest frost shards and the softest snowfall. Before the permafrost monarch of winter, lay your heart down: become the right hand of the cold.

gear-armour#0146.src: This suit was clearly designed by the hand of a mechanic, though its purpose is unknown. There are quite a lot of buttons on it though, so let's press this one!
gear-armour#0146.dst: 這套裝顯然出自某位技師之手，用途不明。不過上面按鈕還真不少，那就先按這個吧！
gear-armour#0146.flat: This suit was clearly designed by the hand of a mechanic, though its purpose is unknown. There are quite a lot of buttons on it though, so let's press this one!

gear-armour#0147.src: Forged in direct tribute to the earth and its aspects, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0147.dst: 直接為了向大地及其諸相致敬而鍛，這雙工藝精緻的靴子，只授予擊敗過蜂巢女主人的人。
gear-armour#0147.flat: Forged in direct tribute to the earth and its aspects, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0148.src: True to their promise, these goggles were left as a memento for Ohms when his lover Gale finally died. Light as air, Gale's carefree nature lends itself to those who don them.
gear-armour#0148.dst: 如同承諾的那樣，當 Ohms 的愛人 Gale 終於離世時，這副護目鏡被留下作為紀念。輕如空氣，Gale 那份無拘無束的性情也一併傳給了戴上它的人。
gear-armour#0148.flat: True to their promise, these goggles were left as a memento for Ohms when his lover Gale finally died. Light as air, Gale's carefree nature lends itself to those who don them.

gear-armour#0149.src: Forged with the raw powers of both the earth and the sea, these boots were initially an attempt at creating a method of foot-travel over the seas. Despite the spectacular failure of that application, they remain a formidable and reliable set of armor.
gear-armour#0149.dst: 這雙靴子以大地與海洋的原初之力鍛成，最初是為了讓人能徒步渡海而造。儘管那個用途失敗得極其徹底，它至今仍是一件強悍而可靠的護甲。
gear-armour#0149.flat: Forged with the raw powers of both the earth and the sea, these boots were initially an attempt at creating a method of foot-travel over the seas. Despite the spectacular failure of that application, they remain a formidable and reliable set of armor.

gear-armour#0150.src: Those who believe in chances are the most foolish - every step forward is a step closer to demise. Greed blinds their eyes, as it guides their souls to eternal despair.
gear-armour#0150.dst: 相信機率的人是最愚蠢的——每往前一步，都是離毀滅更近一步。貪婪蒙蔽了他們的眼，也把他們的靈魂引向永恆的絕望。
gear-armour#0150.flat: Those who believe in chances are the most foolish - every step forward is a step closer to demise. Greed blinds their eyes, as it guides their souls to eternal despair.

gear-armour#0151.src: "Strangest thing, it turns out Creepers are incredibly flammable..." -Garull, Cryptid Researcher
gear-armour#0151.dst: 「最奇怪的是，原來苦力怕超級易燃……」—Garull，神祕生物研究者
gear-armour#0151.flat: "Strangest thing, it turns out Creepers are incredibly flammable..." -Garull, Cryptid Researcher

gear-armour#0152.src: The gods of air and thunder, frustrated with being physically insubstantial alone, decided to band together to forge the ultimate leggings of defense.
gear-armour#0152.dst: 風與雷的神祇厭倦了各自單獨存在時的虛無縹緲，於是決定聯手鍛造出終極的防禦護腿。
gear-armour#0152.flat: The gods of air and thunder, frustrated with being physically insubstantial alone, decided to band together to forge the ultimate leggings of defense.

gear-armour#0153.src: An eerie glimpse into what once was, shining beautifully in the infinite expanse of the Void. As tragic a tale it is, perhaps it is better left a wisp.
gear-armour#0153.dst: 對曾經存在之物的一瞥，詭異而美麗地閃耀在虛空的無盡之中。故事雖然悲慘，或許就讓它留作一縷微光比較好。
gear-armour#0153.flat: An eerie glimpse into what once was, shining beautifully in the infinite expanse of the Void. As tragic a tale it is, perhaps it is better left a wisp.

gear-armour#0154.src: Found in a mystically-charged Giant ruin, these snug boots recall fond memories, incite calmness, and provide comfort for the wearer.
gear-armour#0154.dst: 在一處充滿神祕能量的巨人遺跡中尋獲，這雙合腳的靴子會喚起美好的回憶、帶來平靜，也給予穿戴者慰藉。
gear-armour#0154.flat: Found in a mystically-charged Giant ruin, these snug boots recall fond memories, incite calmness, and provide comfort for the wearer.

gear-armour#0155.src: This ill-fitting, bulky chestplate was never intended to be a chestplate at all. Rather, it is a broken fragment of an arm bracer, from the time of giants.
gear-armour#0155.dst: 這件不合身又笨重的胸甲，本來根本就不是拿來當胸甲的。它其實是一副護臂的殘片——來自巨人的時代。
gear-armour#0155.flat: This ill-fitting, bulky chestplate was never intended to be a chestplate at all. Rather, it is a broken fragment of an arm bracer, from the time of giants.

gear-armour#0156.src: History measures empires; what are you, if not but a subtle flicker-masked within the brilliance of generations past?
gear-armour#0156.dst: 歷史衡量的是帝國；那麼你算什麼呢，若不過是一絲微弱的閃爍——被前人世代的燦爛所掩蓋？
gear-armour#0156.flat: History measures empires; what are you, if not but a subtle flicker-masked within the brilliance of generations past?

gear-armour#0157.src: "With the corruption seemingly tied to the emeralds dug by the Roots, people thought gold was the next best thing, the idiots." -Gerald, Retired Miner
gear-armour#0157.dst: 「既然腐敗看起來跟 Roots 挖出來的綠寶石有關，大家就以為黃金是下一個好選擇——那群蠢貨。」——Gerald，退休礦工
gear-armour#0157.flat: "With the corruption seemingly tied to the emeralds dug by the Roots, people thought gold was the next best thing, the idiots." -Gerald, Retired Miner

gear-armour#0158.src: Sometimes it takes a heart of stone to do what must be done.
gear-armour#0158.dst: 有時候得有一顆石頭做的心，才做得了非做不可的事。
gear-armour#0158.flat: Sometimes it takes a heart of stone to do what must be done.

gear-armour#0159.src: No one knows how this extremely dense chestplate can even logically exist. It is almost paradoxical in nature, and affects its wearers in unfathomable ways.
gear-armour#0159.dst: 沒有人知道這件密度極高的胸甲在邏輯上究竟怎麼可能存在。它的本質近乎自相矛盾，並以難以理解的方式影響著穿戴者。
gear-armour#0159.flat: No one knows how this extremely dense chestplate can even logically exist. It is almost paradoxical in nature, and affects its wearers in unfathomable ways.

gear-armour#0160.src: Sculpted by searing flames and dazzling light, in the years since the Fracturing the Greatbirds' nest has developed a blinding glow. It has both immense power and volatility, yet seems to hold a hidden strength for one who can tame its spirit.
gear-armour#0160.dst: 由灼熱的火焰與炫目的光雕塑而成；自「碎裂」以來的這些年裡，巨鳥之巢已生出一層刺眼的光輝。它既蘊含龐大的力量，也極不穩定；但對於能馴服其靈的人，它似乎藏著一份深不可測的力量。
gear-armour#0160.flat: Sculpted by searing flames and dazzling light, in the years since the Fracturing the Greatbirds' nest has developed a blinding glow. It has both immense power and volatility, yet seems to hold a hidden strength for one who can tame its spirit.

gear-armour#0161.src: Sleek black plates, harder than steel, tougher than granite. Threads of ancient magick weave themselves through the material, granting you all the power of the dark stone.
gear-armour#0161.dst: 流線的黑色甲片，硬過鋼、韌過花崗岩。古老魔法的絲線穿織在材質之中，把那塊黑石的全部力量都交給了你。
gear-armour#0161.flat: Sleek black plates, harder than steel, tougher than granite. Threads of ancient magick weave themselves through the material, granting you all the power of the dark stone.

gear-armour#0162.src: Forged from mystic, previously unknown metals revealed in the deepest dwarven mining site to date, these sleek, glowing greaves are believed to be utterly indestructible.
gear-armour#0162.dst: 以至今最深的矮人礦場中揭露的神祕未知金屬鍛成，這副流線而發光的脛甲，被認為是絕對堅不可摧的。
gear-armour#0162.flat: Forged from mystic, previously unknown metals revealed in the deepest dwarven mining site to date, these sleek, glowing greaves are believed to be utterly indestructible.

gear-armour#0163.src: The sweater has the quote "I'm feeling PINE, what about you" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0163.dst: 毛衣正面織著一句話：「I'm feeling PINE, what about you」——我感覺挺好的(松樹的 PINE 與 fine 同音)，你呢？
gear-armour#0163.flat: The sweater has the quote "I'm feeling PINE, what about you" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0164.src: The old facemasks of the Eradian guards were forged from raw magma, and enchanted to remain searingly hot, so as to brand the wearer eternally with the mark of {p}'s elite.
gear-armour#0164.dst: Eradian 衛兵的舊式面罩以原始的岩漿鍛成，並被施法保持在灼熱的狀態，好在穿戴者身上永遠烙下 {p} 精銳的印記。
gear-armour#0164.flat: The old facemasks of the Eradian guards were forged from raw magma, and enchanted to remain searingly hot, so as to brand the wearer eternally with the mark of {p}'s elite.
gear-armour#0164._raw: The old facemasks of the Eradian guards were forged from raw magma, and enchanted to remain searingly hot, so as to brand the wearer eternally with the mark of Rodoroc's elite.

gear-armour#0165.src: The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside {p}. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet....It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0165.dst: 前一任主人似乎在 {p} 城外的不死大軍中遭遇了不測。染了血，但還能用……沾一點腐敗又不會怎樣，對吧……它正被什麼東西牽引著。
gear-armour#0165.flat: The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside {p}. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet....It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0165._raw: The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside Ragni. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet....It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0166.src: A paper cut triggers immediate cauterization. A cracked rib is instantly encased in a cage of white-hot plasma. You did not ask to wake up smoking every morning, but according to diagnostic logs, your survival rate has never been higher.
gear-armour#0166.dst: 一道紙割傷會立刻被燒灼止血。一根裂開的肋骨會馬上被封進一籠白熾的電漿裡。你並沒有要求每天早上醒來時身上都在冒煙，但根據診斷紀錄，你的存活率從來沒有這麼高過。
gear-armour#0166.flat: A paper cut triggers immediate cauterization. A cracked rib is instantly encased in a cage of white-hot plasma. You did not ask to wake up smoking every morning, but according to diagnostic logs, your survival rate has never been higher.

gear-armour#0167.src: An age of formation. To spark the chain reaction of everything, and to predate nothing. To bombard the world with violent impact after violent impact, building a beautiful, delicate foundation from the firestorm of the cosmos. All things must begin.
gear-armour#0167.dst: 一個成形的紀元。點燃萬物的連鎖反應，且不以任何事物為先。一次又一次以猛烈的撞擊轟擊這個世界，從宇宙的火風暴之中築起一個美麗而纖細的基礎。萬物都必須有個開端。
gear-armour#0167.flat: An age of formation. To spark the chain reaction of everything, and to predate nothing. To bombard the world with violent impact after violent impact, building a beautiful, delicate foundation from the firestorm of the cosmos. All things must begin.

gear-armour#0168.src: Childhood memories, days of late nights and snow fights and cocoa by the fireside. Loving smiles and friendly faces. The beating heart of the world: home. This is what you fight for, beating back those dark and wicked forces which work to break down all that is loved. There is no sacrifice too great for the hearth.
gear-armour#0168.dst: 童年的記憶，那些熬夜、打雪仗、在爐火邊喝可可的日子。慈愛的笑容，友善的面孔。世界跳動的心臟：家。你為的就是這個而戰，把那些想拆掉一切所愛的黑暗與邪惡逼退回去。為了那座爐火，沒有什麼犧牲算得上太大。
gear-armour#0168.flat: Childhood memories, days of late nights and snow fights and cocoa by the fireside. Loving smiles and friendly faces. The beating heart of the world: home. This is what you fight for, beating back those dark and wicked forces which work to break down all that is loved. There is no sacrifice too great for the hearth.

gear-armour#0169.src: This peculiar shawl is eternally warm to the touch, and shimmers brilliantly in the sunlight. It is rumored to give amazing health benefits and good fortune to those who wear it.
gear-armour#0169.dst: 這條奇特的披肩摸起來永遠是暖的，在陽光下閃耀得無比燦爛。傳聞它能為穿戴者帶來驚人的健康與好運。
gear-armour#0169.flat: This peculiar shawl is eternally warm to the touch, and shimmers brilliantly in the sunlight. It is rumored to give amazing health benefits and good fortune to those who wear it.

gear-armour#0170.src: Honoring a mythical dwarven smith lost to the legends, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0170.dst: 為紀念一位失落於傳說之中的神話矮人鐵匠，這雙工藝精緻的靴子，只授予擊敗過蜂巢女主人的人。
gear-armour#0170.flat: Honoring a mythical dwarven smith lost to the legends, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0171.src: What once crowned the Commander of Aelumia's Gendarmerie, now reduced to a singed fragment of its former self.
gear-armour#0171.dst: 它曾是 Aelumia 憲兵指揮官的頭冠，如今只剩下一塊燒焦的殘片。
gear-armour#0171.flat: What once crowned the Commander of Aelumia's Gendarmerie, now reduced to a singed fragment of its former self.

gear-armour#0172.src: It bears the visage of a great hero. Thank you for participating in the Festival of the Heroes!
gear-armour#0172.dst: 面具上是一位偉大英雄的容貌。感謝你參與英雄慶典！
gear-armour#0172.flat: It bears the visage of a great hero. Thank you for participating in the Festival of the Heroes!

gear-armour#0173.src: The make of this massive cloak is unlike anything seen before among the provinces. Foreign images shift and melt in ethereal projections within the inside.
gear-armour#0173.dst: 這件巨大斗篷的做工，在各省之中都不曾見過。異邦的影像在它內裡以某種靈體般的投影變換、消融。
gear-armour#0173.flat: The make of this massive cloak is unlike anything seen before among the provinces. Foreign images shift and melt in ethereal projections within the inside.

gear-armour#0174.src: Many blacksmiths have tried to craft their products in this armor's image, but none so far have been able to capture the brilliance of these Bovemist-blessed greaves.
gear-armour#0174.dst: 許多鐵匠都試著仿照這件護甲來打造自己的作品，但至今沒有一個人能重現這雙受 Bovemist 祝福的護脛所散發的光輝。
gear-armour#0174.flat: Many blacksmiths have tried to craft their products in this armor's image, but none so far have been able to capture the brilliance of these Bovemist-blessed greaves.

gear-armour#0175.src: Let time slip away. The nature of the mind is to wander, so stare blankly at the sky, let go of your worries, and enjoy a carefree day.
gear-armour#0175.dst: 讓時間流走吧。心智的本性就是遊蕩——所以放空地望著天空，放下你的煩惱，享受無憂無慮的一天。
gear-armour#0175.flat: Let time slip away. The nature of the mind is to wander, so stare blankly at the sky, let go of your worries, and enjoy a carefree day.

gear-armour#0176.src: Forgotten long ago, these boots curse the wearer with an endless hunger.
gear-armour#0176.dst: 早已被遺忘的這雙靴子，會以無止盡的飢餓詛咒穿戴者。
gear-armour#0176.flat: Forgotten long ago, these boots curse the wearer with an endless hunger.

gear-armour#0177.src: Standing hundreds of metres in the sky, the mist hides the ground far below you. Every step must be taken with caution, or else-
gear-armour#0177.dst: 站在數百公尺的高空，霧遮住了底下遙遠的地面。每一步都必須小心翼翼，否則——
gear-armour#0177.flat: Standing hundreds of metres in the sky, the mist hides the ground far below you. Every step must be taken with caution, or else-
